knowledge:
- key_parameters: files=Vector of paths to bedgraph files to be imported ;; ref_cpgs=A list of genome-wide CpG sites extracted from a reference genome using extract_CPGs ;; pipeline=Preset name (e.g., "Bismark", "MethylDackel", "MethylcTools") to automatically parse bedgraph columns ;; chr_idx=Column index for chromosome names in custom bedgraphs ;; start_idx=Column index for start positions in custom bedgraphs ;; M_idx=Column index for methylated counts in custom bedgraphs ;; U_idx=Column index for unmethylated counts in custom bedgraphs ;; coldata=A data.frame containing sample annotations ;; m=A methrix object passed to downstream analysis functions ;; type=Type of matrix to extract ("C" for coverage, "M" for methylation) or plot type ;; cov_thr=Minimum coverage threshold for filtering ;; min_samples=Minimum number of samples that must meet the coverage threshold ;; contigs=Chromosomes/contigs to subset by ;; regions=Genomic regions (GRanges or data.table) to subset by ;; samples=Sample names to subset by
- alternatives: bsseq=An alternative package and object class for bisulfite sequencing data. methrix provides methrix2bsseq to convert objects to BSseq format for downstream smoothing or differential methylation calling. methrix subsetting is noted to be several orders of magnitude faster than bsseq due to its data.table-based binary search.
- when_to_use: Use this package when you have raw bedgraph files from bisulfite sequencing (WGBS/RRBS) and need to parse them, perform quality control, filter out low-coverage sites or SNPs, perform exploratory analysis (PCA, violin plots, coverage density plots), and prepare the data for downstream differential methylation analysis.
- pitfalls: Installation from Bioconductor requires matching R and Bioc versions, which may cause incompatibilities with older R versions (installing from GitHub is recommended as a workaround). If bedgraphs lack explicit beta and coverage columns, methrix will estimate them from M and U values, which may increase processing time. Uncovered loci (containing NAs across all samples) should be explicitly removed using remove_uncovered to avoid downstream analysis issues.

workflows.name: methrix_methylation_analysis
workflows.intent: Import raw bedgraph files, perform quality control, filter out low-quality sites and SNPs, subset genomic regions, and visualize methylation and coverage profiles.
workflows.stages: 1. Extract reference CpG sites using extract_CPGs ;; 2. Read bedgraph files and create a methrix object using read_bedgraphs ;; 3. Generate an interactive HTML QC report using methrix_report ;; 4. Filter out uncovered loci using remove_uncovered ;; 5. Filter out SNPs using remove_snps ;; 6. Extract coverage and methylation matrices using get_matrix ;; 7. Filter sites based on coverage thresholds using coverage_filter ;; 8. Subset the dataset by contigs, regions, or samples using subset_methrix ;; 9. Calculate summary statistics using get_stats and plot them using plot_stats ;; 10. Perform PCA and plot results using methrix_pca and plot_pca ;; 11. Visualize data using plot_violin and plot_coverage ;; 12. Convert the methrix object to a BSseq object using methrix2bsseq
workflows.code:
hg19_cpgs <- suppressWarnings(methrix::extract_CPGs(ref_genome = "BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19"))

meth <- methrix::read_bedgraphs(
  files = bdg_files,
  ref_cpgs = hg19_cpgs,
  chr_idx = 1,
  start_idx = 2,
  M_idx = 3,
  U_idx = 4,
  stranded = FALSE,
  zero_based = FALSE, 
  collapse_strands = FALSE, 
  coldata = sample_anno
)

methrix::methrix_report(meth = meth, output_dir = tempdir())

meth = methrix::remove_uncovered(m = meth)

library(MafDb.1Kgenomes.phase3.hs37d5)
library(GenomicScores)

meth_snps_filtered <- methrix::remove_snps(m = meth)

coverage_mat <- methrix::get_matrix(m = methrix_data, type = "C")

meth_mat <- methrix::get_matrix(m = methrix_data, type = "M")

meth_mat_with_loci <- methrix::get_matrix(m = methrix_data, type = "M", add_loci = TRUE, in_granges = TRUE)

methrix::coverage_filter(m = methrix_data, cov_thr = 3, min_samples = 2)

methrix::subset_methrix(m = methrix_data, contigs = "chr21")

target_loci <- GenomicRanges::GRanges("chr21:27867971-27868103")

methrix::subset_methrix(m = methrix_data, regions = target_loci)

methrix::subset_methrix(m = methrix_data, samples = "C1")

methrix_data[,1]

meth_stats <- get_stats(m = methrix_data)

plot_stats(plot_dat = meth_stats, what = "C", stat = "mean")

plot_stats(plot_dat = meth_stats, what = "M", stat = "mean")

mpca <- methrix_pca(m = methrix_data, do_plot = FALSE)

plot_pca(pca_res = mpca, show_labels = TRUE)

plot_pca(pca_res = mpca, m = methrix_data, col_anno = "Condition")

methrix::plot_violin(m = methrix_data)

methrix::plot_coverage(m = methrix_data, type = "dens")

library(bsseq)
bs_seq <- methrix::methrix2bsseq(m = methrix_data)
